explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/918: the [Er69b] version with '= ℵ₀' is trivially impossible for general subgraphs (louisd), because an edgeless subgraph on ℵ₁ vertices has χ = 1. The statement asserts there is no graph with ℵ₂ vertices and χ = ℵ₂ all of whose ℵ₁-vertex subgraphs have χ = ℵ₀. True by that argument. Faithful.
